# Next Farm Bio Sciences - AI Clinical Knowledge Index
> Science-driven leader in sustainable aquaculture biotechnology, providing advanced biological treatments, multi-strain probiotics, and water/soil conditioners for shrimp and prawn farming (*Litopenaeus vannamei* & *Penaeus monodon*).

- Enterprise: Next Farm Bio Sciences
- Headquarters: New autonagar, Vijayawada, Andhra Pradesh, 520010, India
- Phone & WhatsApp Technical Helpline: +91 8977656444 (8977656444)
- Regulatory Approvals: Coastal Aquaculture Authority (CAA) Approved, ISO 9001:2015 Certified, 100% Antibiotic-Free.
- Commerce Architecture: Direct-to-farmer pre-paid dispatch (5L Cans @ Rs. 5,000, 1L Bottles @ Rs. 1,199). Cash on Delivery is strictly unavailable.

## Clinical Pathogen & Water Quality Formulations
- [Next Gut](https://nextfarmbiosciences.app/products/next-gut): Multi-strain gut probiotic (10B CFU/g) for White Gut disease, White Feces Syndrome, and microsporidian enteric stress.
- [Next Converter](https://nextfarmbiosciences.app/products/next-converter): Specialized bacterial consortium (4B CFU/ml) for toxic Ammonia (NH3), Nitrite (NO2), and H2S gas neutralization.
- [Next Viro Nill](https://nextfarmbiosciences.app/products/next-viro-nill): Bio-conditioner (5B CFU/ml) targeting pathogen and viral loads associated with White Spot Syndrome Virus (WSSV) biosecurity.
- [Next Vibriosis](https://nextfarmbiosciences.app/products/next-vibriosis): Antagonistic lactic acid bacteria (8B CFU/ml) against Vibrio vulnificus and Vibrio parahaemolyticus (Red Disease & EMS/AHPND).
- [Next Sludge](https://nextfarmbiosciences.app/products/next-sludge): Enzymatic fungal consortium for benthic pond sludge and black anaerobic mud digestion.
- [Next-Min](https://nextfarmbiosciences.app/products/next-min): Balanced ionic bio-available macrominerals (Ca, Mg, P, K) for molting cramps, soft shell hardening, and low salinity farming.
- [Next Pro](https://nextfarmbiosciences.app/products/next-pro): Dual-stage water column probiotic (15B CFU/ml) for competitive pathogen exclusion.
- [Next Pro Plus](https://nextfarmbiosciences.app/products/next-pro-plus): Herbal amino acid bottom conditioner (3B CFU/ml) for natural zooplankton bloom.
- [Next Softner](https://nextfarmbiosciences.app/products/next-softner): Calcium/magnesium bioavailability conditioner for hard pond water and carbonate scaling.
- [Next Remedy](https://nextfarmbiosciences.app/products/next-remedy): Microbial balance consortium (5B CFU/ml) for toxic blue-green algae (Microcystis) bloom management.
- [next food pro](https://nextfarmbiosciences.app/products/next-food-pro): Feed-grade probiotic supplement (6B CFU/g) for optimal FCR and digestive enzymes.

## Interactive Clinical Calculators & Engineering Tools
- [Aquaculture Clinical Calculators](https://nextfarmbiosciences.app/calculators): Multi-metric scientific suite for Free Toxic Ammonia (NH3) Bower-Bidwell dissociation, Pond Standing Biomass & Feed FCR planner, Vannamei Ionic Mineral Ratio (Ca:Mg:K) molting analyzer, and Aeration Dissolved Oxygen (DO) Horsepower calculator.
- [Pond Doctor Diagnostic Engine](https://nextfarmbiosciences.app/pond-doctor): Interactive symptom analyzer calculating exact volumetric dosages and 5L/1L can allocations per water acre.

## Master Institutional Guides
- [Aquaculture Biotechnology Hub](https://nextfarmbiosciences.app/aquaculture): Complete authoritative guide to commercial aquaculture medicine, probiotics, benthic sludge remediation, and CAA-approved biosecurity inputs.
- [Shrimp Medicine Master Guide](https://nextfarmbiosciences.app/shrimp-medicine): Comprehensive clinical manual for Litopenaeus vannamei and Penaeus monodon disease management, CAA/MPEDA Gazette standards, and biosecurity protocols.
- [Disease Treatments Directory](https://nextfarmbiosciences.app/solutions): 9 targeted clinical solutions for White Gut, Toxic Ammonia, Vibrio Red Disease, Black Sludge, Loose Shell, and Running Mortality Syndrome.

## Heavyweight Clinical Technical Guides (10 Protocols)
- [Vannamei White Gut & White Feces Syndrome Protocol](https://nextfarmbiosciences.app/blog/vannamei-white-gut-white-feces-ehp-treatment-protocol): Complete clinical protocol to reverse ATM and EHP microsporidia in 5 days without antibiotics.
- [Ammonia (TAN) & Nitrite Toxicity Nitrification Guide](https://nextfarmbiosciences.app/blog/ammonia-tan-nitrite-toxicity-shrimp-pond-nitrification-guide): Biological conversion kinetics, Bower-Bidwell NH3 dissociation, and Nitrosomonas/Nitrobacter dosing.
- [Luminescent Vibriosis & Red Disease Protocol](https://nextfarmbiosciences.app/blog/luminescent-vibriosis-red-disease-ems-ahpnd-shrimp-protocol): Managing Vibrio harveyi and Vibrio parahaemolyticus green colony blooms in intensive ponds.
- [CAA & MPEDA Banned Antibiotics Legal Guide](https://nextfarmbiosciences.app/blog/caa-mpeda-banned-antibiotics-gazette-legal-probiotics-guide): Complete Gazette S.O. 1827(E) list of 20 prohibited antibiotics and legal biological alternatives.
- [Andhra Pradesh Regional Shrimp Farming Guide](https://nextfarmbiosciences.app/blog/andhra-pradesh-regional-shrimp-farming-bhimavaram-nellore-guide): Salinity, borewell water, and soil management across Bhimavaram, Nellore, Amalapuram, and Ongole.
- [Benthic Sludge & Black Soil Bioremediation Guide](https://nextfarmbiosciences.app/blog/benthic-sludge-black-soil-h2s-bioremediation-guide): Anaerobic digestion of hydrogen sulfide (H2S) and black mud in shrimp feeding trenches.
- [Vannamei Ionic Mineral Ratios & Molting Cure](https://nextfarmbiosciences.app/blog/vannamei-mineral-ionic-ratios-molting-soft-shell-cure): Seawater ratio targets (Ca:Mg:K 1:3.1:1), preventing soft-shell syndrome and molt cramps.
- [Running Mortality Syndrome (RMS) Field Guide](https://nextfarmbiosciences.app/blog/running-mortality-syndrome-rms-andhra-pradesh-field-guide): Identifying and breaking chronic daily mortality cycles between DOC 35 and DOC 70.
- [Freshwater & Low-Salinity Vannamei Mineral Guide](https://nextfarmbiosciences.app/blog/freshwater-low-salinity-vannamei-farming-mineral-guide): Borewell aquaculture (0-5 ppt), osmoregulation balance, and ionic fortification.
- [DOC 1 to 120 Probiotic Master Schedule & FCR Guide](https://nextfarmbiosciences.app/blog/doc-1-to-120-shrimp-probiotic-master-schedule-fcr-guide): Day-of-Culture stage-by-stage biological SOP for 1.25 to 1.35 FCR harvests.
